HealthDojo · synthetic homes, exact labels

HealthDojo — the flight simulator for home-health AI.

Home-health AI is moving into patients' homes, and the only way to test it today is on real patients. HealthDojo turns real clinical guidelines into synthetic homes with exact, verified labels, so AI companies can pressure-test their models before a single patient trial.

Why now
Healthcare AI is moving into the home — and it has nowhere to train.
01 · Humanoid & home robots

Sharing homes with older adults

1X NEO, Figure and others are about to move in — they have to know a towel bar is not a grab bar.

02 · Smart glasses & vision wearables

Seeing the home through the user's eyes

Meta Ray-Ban Display and peers can look at every room the patient walks through.

03 · Home-health & care apps

Assessing homes from a phone camera

Discharge, remote-monitoring and caregiver apps — a wave of them, all judging safety from pixels.

Every one needs to be tested before it meets a patient. Today the only test is real patients. HealthDojo is the dojo: well-validated, guideline-grounded environments where models and apps train and get pressure-tested.

Who it's for

Built for the builders. Rated for the buyers.

01 · Home robots

Humanoids & home robots

Train and certify hazard perception in walkable 3D homes before sharing a hallway with an 80-year-old on a walker.

02 · Smart glasses & wearables

Vision on the patient's face

Score what the device notices — and what it misses — from the user's own point of view.

03 · Home-health & care apps

Pressure-test before the pilot

Discharge, remote-monitoring and caregiver apps find blind spots on synthetic homes instead of real patients.

Buyers · hospitals & payers under CJR-X

An independent rating

Same homes, same clinical rubric, every vendor — choose which AI to trust with the 90-day episode.

The moat isn't rendering homes — it's turning guidelines into verified, clinician-signed labels, and every failure we find makes the simulator harder.

Honest caveats

  • Synthetic homes only — no real-patient homes yet.
  • Rubric is original synthesis cross-walked to the guidelines; pending OT/PT clinician review.
  • Small n: {{SMALLN}}. Treat rankings as directional.
  • Sim-to-real is next, with HomeReady as customer zero.
